svg.title: How StreamCast works
svg.desc: Any stream source feeds StreamCast, which places a live radio player anywhere on your site through the block, a shortcode, or any page builder.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ONE PLUGIN · ANY STREAM · ANYWHERE ON YOUR SITE
